g.text: Permanent supervisor installation and admitted work
One monotonic 30s handshake deadline (validated lower override).
Callback publication completes only after callback returns/throws.
Permanent state cannot be rolled back.
Failed listener health rejects new registrations.
Pinned proc/pidfd and typed root/dirfd capabilities.
Exact owned-descriptor handoff through private IPC.
Reuse slot only after previous child is reaped.
